# truefoundry_virtual_account (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry virtual account (service account) and its permissions. The account's API token is exposed as the sensitive `token` attribute; alternatively, `secret_store_config` syncs it into a secret store. Existing accounts can be imported by their ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service account for CI with access to one provider account.
resource "truefoundry_virtual_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci-bot"

  permissions = [
    {
      resource_fqn  = "my-tenant:azure-openai:my-azure-openai"
      resource_type = "provider-account"
      role_id       = "provider-account-access"
    },
  ]

  expiration_date = "2027-01-31"
  token_type      = "jwt"
  tags            = { env = "production" }

  # Optional: sync the token into a secret store instead of consuming
  # the sensitive `token` attribute from state.
  secret_store_config = {
    integration_fqn = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault"
    secret_path     = "tfy/virtualaccounts/ci-bot/value"
  }
}

output "ci_bot_token" {
  value     = truefoundry_virtual_account.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the virtual account. Changing it replaces the account (and its token).
- `permissions` (Attributes List) Roles granted to this virtual account on specific resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Optional

- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date of the account in yyyy-mm-dd format. Unset means no expiration.
- `secret_store_config` (Attributes) Sync the account token into a secret store, e.g. Vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_store_config))
- `tags` (Map of String) Key-value pairs to categorize this virtual account.
- `token_type` (String) Format of the issued token: `jwt` or `opaque`. Unset uses the platform default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the virtual account.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Current API token of the virtual account. Refreshed on read, so out-of-band token rotations are picked up.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `resource_fqn` (String) FQN of the resource the role applies to, e.g. a provider account FQN.
- `resource_type` (String) Type of the resource, e.g. provider-account, cluster, workspace.
- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. provider-account-access.


<a id="nestedatt--secret_store_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_store_config`

Required:

- `integration_fqn` (String) FQN of the secret store integration.
- `secret_path` (String) Path under which the token is stored.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Virtual accounts are imported by their control plane ID; the current
# token is fetched on the first read after import.
terraform import truefoundry_virtual_account.ci cmneogofq0002016y0anr48bj
```
